## Rule

Team-best LIVE (manifest, cost **460**, sha `ff0694c98a21…`) is a single grouped Conv, `group=2`, `W[10,5,3,3]`+`b[10]`, pads=1. Decoded:
- `out[0] = in[0] − nbr8(in[2]) − 0.5`
- `out[1] = 8·in[0] + 9·in[1] + nbr8(in[2]) − 8.5`
- `out[2..9] = in[2..9]` (identity pass-through)
- `nbr8(x)` = 8-neighbour sum = box3×3(x) − x. (graph name: `t352_3x3_dilate_2_draw_1_preserve_colors`)

## Algorithm sketch

`nbr8` = Conv with ring kernel `[[1,1,1],[1,0,1],[1,1,1]]`; ring = ones3×3 − center (ones3×3 is rank-1/separable, ring is rank-2). Only 2 rank-2 kernels exist (both the same ring in out0/out1).

## Attempts

| date | approach | result | cost | note |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| 2026-07-03 | LIVE single grouped Conv (bar) | — | **460** | mem 0 + params 460 |
| 2026-07-03 | rank-factor / separable-split arith (Split+box-Conv+Mul/Add/Sub+Concat), 17 params | visible PASS, byte-equal to LIVE | **64,817** | mem 64,800 kills it |
| 2026-07-03 | minimal 2-node (Conv → Add-bias) | — | **36,460** | one F32 intermediate = 36,000 B |

**Verdict: WALL @ 460 (forced floor).** Full proof: `Task_by_Task/task352/hard_records/rank_factor_wall.md`.

## Cost analysis

Cost = `memory + params`. `params` = element COUNT (`math.prod(dims)`), independent of sparsity/rank — so "27/450 nonzero" and rank-1 factoring save nothing; the `[10,5,3,3]` shape is forced by 10 out-channels at group=2 (only equal divisor of 10 that fits the {0,1,2} cross-channel coupling). `memory` sums every node-output tensor except the two named `input`/`output`; min spatial intermediate `[1,1,30,30]`=900 B (even BOOL) already exceeds 460. So any ≥2-node rewrite loses, and the single-Conv floor is exactly 450+10=460.

## Don't-do log

- **Do NOT re-explore rank-factorization / separable-split / zero-channel-drop for task352.** Params count elements not nonzeros (no ONNX sparse Conv); factoring adds nodes → adds ≥900 B charged intermediates. 460 is the forced floor under memory+params. (2026-07-03, bo_ng_cld_worker3)
